newsitem.title: USA: Freeport withdraws from Bre-X project.
newsitem.headline: Freeport withdraws from Bre-X project.

text.p: Freeport-McMoRan Copper & Gold Inc said Monday it will notify Bre-X Minerals Ltd it is withdrawing from the Busang project based on information obtained during Freeport's due diligence review.
The information was confirmed by results of the Strathcona Mineral Services Ltd's technical audit of the project prepared for Bre-X, Freeport said.

The company said only trace amounts of gold were found in the samples assayed and, "as a consequence, we believe there to be virtually no possibility of an economic gold deposit in the Southeast Zone 1 South of the Busang property."

Noting the assaying of the samples submitted by Bre-X to Indo Assay Laboratories in Balikpapan, Indonesia, has been of a good standard, Freeport stated "The gold recovered in samples submitted by Bre-X has originated from a source other than the Southeast Zone of the Busang property and has resulted in falsification and misrepresentation of many thousands of samples with consequent and subsequent erroneous estimates of gold resources."
Freeport has the right to participate as a 15 percent owner of the project, subject to the confirmation of the existence of a commercially viable resource.
The company said this does not appear to exist based on the information obtained during its due diligence review, confirmed by the results of the Strathcona audit.
Freeport said it was provided, late in the afternoon on May 4, with Strathcona's interim report on its technical audit of the Busang project prepared for Bre-X.

In connection with this audit, Strathcona completed a closely supervised six-hole core drilling program which Freeport monitored. Strathcona selected an initial 350 meters of core for assaying at laboratories in Australia, Indonesia and Canada.

Freeport said Strathcona described its assay results as "quite conclusive" and stated that these results "...along with work done by Freeport, results from recent drill core samples submitted by Bre-X, and other investigations and observations we have made, we are able to express without reservation the following opinions and conclusions concerning the main area of interest on the Busang property, the Southeast Zone 1 South, and to which we anticipate no changes in our final report...".
